help_entry_hint: Connection guide, shop tutorials and client downloads
help_intro: Start with the steps below, then check this shop’s tutorials and configured download sources. External links open outside Mini App.
help_step_install: Choose a client for your operating system from the downloads below. Check that it supports your service type.
help_step_service: Open My services, choose your service and check its status, remaining data and expiry.
help_step_import: For a subscription service, tap the subscription link to copy it, then import/paste the link into the client. If available, scan its QR using another device or use the individual configurations shown in service details.
help_step_connect: Update the subscription inside the client, choose an available server and connect. Button names differ between clients.
help_compatibility: A download listed by the shop is not proof that it works with every plan or protocol. If unsure, ask support before installing.
help_wireguard: WireGuard: use the configuration download or QR shown in service details; it is not a normal subscription link. Import it only in a compatible client.
help_account: Account-based service: use the username/password shown in service details with the connection method provided by support. Do not import them as a subscription URL.
help_no_results: No matching items. Clear the search or change the platform.
help_no_articles: This shop has not published tutorials yet. The quick guide above is still available.
help_apps_notice: These are shop-configured sources, not independently verified or guaranteed compatible. Store/release pages open externally; choose the correct version and architecture. This page does not fetch or verify the latest release.
help_no_apps: This shop has not configured usable download links yet. Ask support for a compatible client.
help_bot_hint: For files or Telegram-only instructions, open the same shop’s bot and send /apps or /help. Cached files are not downloaded through Mini App.
help_trouble_hint: Check the service status, remaining data and expiry; update the client’s subscription and note the error message. Open a ticket with your device/client name and error, but never send passwords, private configuration links or payment-card details.
err_help_invalid: The help response could not be read. Try refreshing.
